scope: Application-package optimization-level experiment; separate artifact-size, production functional and physical startup/PSS evidence

control.scope: Application package Rust and local C++ bridge profile experiment; no feature, locale, native SDK, manifest or dependency-profile change

initialConfoundedArtifact.disposition: Rejected before installation; stripping policy differed from the accepted artifact, so this is not an optimization-level-only size comparison

functionalSmoke.scope: Physical production APK functional smoke, not full-text, routing or search-latency acceptance

baselineStartupCohort.metric: Sum dumpsys TOTAL PSS of ALL exclusively owned ActivityManager processes; requires a WebView renderer
limitations: Reference-crop agreement is not independent semantic proof of article identity.
PSS shared mapping attribution depends on other processes; cold means process-cold, not cold page cache.
Separate category medians are not additive; graphics summary and detailed PSS categories can overlap.
Adjacent AB/BA block-median differences are descriptive, not causal or significance estimates.

baselineStartupCohort.mode: startup-enabled; PSS settles after admitted readiness plus launch completion

limitations: Bootstrap/direct native optimizations are already in both artifacts; the package profile is the experimental variable.
Root package includes both Rust and its local C++ archive bridge, not a Rust-only experiment.
SDK, dependency optimization, features, locales, frontend and manifest were preserved.
No causal whole-app saving is inferred from separate cohorts; startup screenshot bounds are coarse and not interactivity or frame timing.
No iPhone, Windows, low-memory-phone or search-latency comparison is established.
